> [!NOTE]
> A note body stays plain.

> [!TIP] Tip title
> A tip with a GitLab-style custom title.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Important body.

> [!WARNING]
> Warning body.

> [!CAUTION]
> Caution body.

> [!note] Lowercase type

> [!NOTE]Tight title

> [!UNKNOWN]
> An unknown type is left literal.

> text before [!NOTE] is not a callout
